newsitem.title: UK: LME copper ends slightly higher in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper ends slightly higher in late trading.

text.p: Copper prices regained impetus above $2,380 in late inter-office trading on Tuesday as fund-based and technical buying picked up further steam.
Traders also noted speculative buying ahead of the possible hike in U.S. interest rates later on Tuesday.
At 1900 GMT three months prices were indicated at $2,386/89 after finishing the kerb at $2,377 a tonne, up $10 from Monday.
Technically, analysts said the market remained range-bound but was building a base around $2,350/60 before moving higher.
Aluminium and nickel were little changed from their kerb close of $1,650 and $7,780 respectively.
